source_quote.quote: Participants whose tumors meet eligibility thresholds for IL13Rα2 and EGFR (and/or EGFRvIII) will receive a dual-target (tandem) CAR-NK product recognizing IL13Rα2 and EGFR/EGFRvIII.
Participants whose tumors meet eligibility thresholds for IL13Rα2 and B7-H3 (CD276) will receive a dual-target (tandem) CAR-NK product recognizing IL13Rα2 and B7-H3.
Participants whose tumors meet eligibility thresholds for EGFR (and/or EGFRvIII) and B7-H3 (CD276) will receive a dual-target (tandem) CAR-NK product recognizing EGFR/EGFRvIII and B7-H3.

coder_notes: CAR-NK cell therapy only -> excluded_intervention_type; no pharmacological candidate. Cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are registered drugs in every arm; their purpose is not stated explicitly, but the record refers to 'lymphodepletion/infusion', so coded supportive (lymphodepleting conditioning, R6). Antigen biomarkers (IL13Ra2, EGFR/EGFRvIII, B7-H3) define cohorts (enrichment) and entry requires at least two of them; they match the CAR targets but the CAR-NK product is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Note the brief summary describes itself as a 'draft, ClinicalTrials.gov-style example record'. Plain 'glioblastoma (WHO grade 4)' with no IDH reference -> cns5 unclear.
